newsitem.title: USA: Telebit Inc and ITK say to merge in 1997 Q3.
newsitem.headline: Telebit Inc and ITK say to merge in 1997 Q3.

text.p: Telebit Inc and ITK Telecommunication AG of Germany, said Monday they plan to merge in the third quarter of 1997.
The two privately held companies did not disclose terms. Neither company was immediately able to comment.
The merged company will be known as ITK International with headquarters in Chelmsford, Mass.
Telebit is a privately held company that was recently created after Telebit Corp was bought by Cisco Systems Inc in Ocotober 1996 through a cash-for-stock merger.
Shortly afterwards, Telebit's management bought out the remaining assets, with financing provided by Cisco, to form a new, privately held company.
